conditions.meaning: Reports whether the workflow accepted the build specification.
Confirms artifact verification on a successful table build.
Reports the end of table workflow shutdown. Read the reason to distinguish clean shutdown from uncertain remote work.
Reports a dependency wait or successful resolution. The ordinary graph workflow can omit this check.
Tracks workflow activity, a capacity wait, or cancellation.
Reports the outcome of the build attempt. Read the parent snapshot for the durable publication.

example.introduction: The build can accept the request while it waits for the referenced Table.
example.nextCheck: Check the dependency’s readiness. Use the parent snapshot’s committed publication to locate the result after the build succeeds.
example.title: When a dependency delays a build

narrative: Read `spec.request.snapshotRef.kind` first. Table and graph builds report different workflow checks. A missing target, identity mismatch, or competing build can set a failure before refreshing conditions. Check `status.phase`, `status.executionPhase`, and `status.failure` together. When `status.failure.code` is `ExecutionPodUnschedulable`, the Pod is waiting for an eligible node. Compare the build's `spec.request.placementTemplateRef` and the Pod's resource requests with node labels, taints, affinity rules and available capacity.

outcomes.guidance: The workflow accepted the specification. A dependency can still delay execution.
The table build verified the canonical snapshot artifact. Read the parent publication for the committed result.
Shutdown ended while remote work was uncertain. Inspect the build’s cleanup disposition before retrying.
The workflow finished shutdown. Inspect the build cleanup state before submitting a replacement.
Inspect the dependency named in the message and check its status before retrying.
The table build resolved its dependencies.
The table build is stopping. Check cleanup before starting another attempt.
Inspect scheduling events for the workflow’s worker pods. Check their resource requests and available node capacity.
The attempt is active. Follow its workflow reference to see which step is running.
Inspect the dependency named in the message and check its status before retrying.
The table build is stopping. Check cleanup before starting another attempt.
The workflow stopped after cancellation. Check cleanup before retrying.
The attempt is active. Follow its workflow reference to see which step is running.
Read the build failure and the referenced workflow for the failed step.
The workflow finished successfully. Check the parent snapshot’s publication before consuming the result.
